newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil quiet, arbs to U.S., Asia beckon.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil quiet, arbs to U.S., Asia beckon.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were mainly unchanged in quiet European business on Monday with many traders away on holiday.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures ended down $3.50 at $211.50 in featureless trade after restoring a $1 backwardation to the Feburary contract from a 50 cent contango.

Traders said that such action as there was featured efforts to obtain scarce vessels for arbitrage opportunities to Asia and the United States. But with many of their counterparties on leave traders reported slow going.
About 180,000 tonnes of Russian is due in the United States this week under NWE arbitrage and two Russians of 90,000 and 120,000 tonnes each are rumoured to be heading to Asia.
Refinery grade heating oil barges were almost $1 higher around Jan IPE +0.50/1.00, largely on the drop in screen values.
Storage material remained at a discount of -$0.50/1.00.
Low sulphur diesel barges were steady at Jan IPE +$10/11.

A small 5,000 tonne cargo of Russian heating oil traded for January 1-5 delivery at Jan IPE $4.75. Heating oil cargoes were steady at Jan IPE +$4/5 for prompt delivery. Low sulphur diesel was steady at around Jan IPE +$15/16.
